fix: Remove the defaults for TARBALL, TAR_SHA and EXPECT_REV and refuse in --go mode unless all three are given, as is already done for --go/--dry-run and TARGET.
reviewer: tools/deploy_fresh.sh:57-60 hardcodes TARBALL from /tank/fn/scratch/qual-69046a76/friends/..., with TAR_SHA and EXPECT_REV pinned to 69046a76. :304-307 checks only that the digest matches the default. A run with --go and no --tarball would retire OLD_NODE (:323-340) and deploy that old friends-layout build. It still needs an explicit --go and TARGET, and the retire is a rename, not a delete, so this is a footgun rather than silent damage.
scenario: An operator or agent runs `deploy_fresh.sh --go auto` and forgets --tarball/--sha256/--expect-rev. The digest check passes because the default sha matches the default file, so the script retires the live node and deploys revision 69046a76 from a scratch qualification directory. That build is a friends-layout tarball, which release-tarball.sh's --frozen form labels 'ungated ... not a release'. The node is moved backward to an old, ungated revision without anyone asking for it. A cleanup of /tank/fn/scratch makes the default fail instead, but with a misleading 'no tarball' message.
title: deploy_fresh.sh defaults deploy a fixed, ungated friends tarball from a scratch path
